meta.title: Obligation
meta.description: We know better than anyone else what should and should not be done.

units.rawText: Crime, I...
units.displayText: Crime, I...

spans.text: Crime, I...

units.rawText: Don't say anything. I know.
units.displayText: Don't say anything. I know.

spans.text: Don't say anything. I know.

units.rawText: Crime pivoted on the spot, not a trace of color on his deathly pale face. He seemed composed, but his quivering lips betrayed his inner heart.
units.displayText: Crime pivoted on the spot, not a trace of color on his deathly pale face. He seemed composed, but his quivering lips betrayed his inner heart.

spans.text: Crime pivoted on the spot, not a trace of color on his deathly pale face. He seemed composed, but his quivering lips betrayed his inner heart.

units.rawText: I... I can't... What do I do, Punishment?
units.displayText: I... I can't... What do I do, Punishment?

spans.text: I... I can't... What do I do, Punishment?

units.rawText: Give me an order, I...
units.displayText: Give me an order, I...

spans.text: Give me an order, I...

units.rawText: ...Crime, you have to face yourself eventually.
units.displayText: ...Crime, you have to face yourself eventually.

spans.text: ...Crime, you have to face yourself eventually.

units.rawText: You cannot always shirk from what you must do, never advancing.
units.displayText: You cannot always shirk from what you must do, never advancing.

spans.text: You cannot always shirk from what you must do, never advancing.

units.rawText: If I'm left alone, what am I to do? I... I cannot carry out the hunt myself...
units.displayText: If I'm left alone, what am I to do? I... I cannot carry out the hunt myself...

spans.text: If I'm left alone, what am I to do? I... I cannot carry out the hunt myself...

units.rawText: It is your obligation.
units.displayText: It is your obligation.

spans.text: It is your obligation.

units.rawText: ...I have some clean bits left. Here.
units.displayText: ...I have some clean bits left. Here.

spans.text: ...I have some clean bits left. Here.

units.rawText: I... I don't want to go back to being like that. I don't want to discover what loneliness is again. I'm better off following commands, listening to them...
units.displayText: I... I don't want to go back to being like that. I don't want to discover what loneliness is again. I'm better off following commands, listening to them...

spans.text: I... I don't want to go back to being like that. I don't want to discover what loneliness is again. I'm better off following commands, listening to them...

units.rawText: You cannot always deceive yourself with the title of Special Intermediate, "Judgment".
units.displayText: You cannot always deceive yourself with the title of Special Intermediate, "Judgment".

spans.text: You cannot always deceive yourself with the title of Special Intermediate, "Judgment".

units.rawText: Go take up your mantle.
units.displayText: Go take up your mantle.

spans.text: Go take up your mantle.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, former Administrator Center area outskirts.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, former Administrator Center area outskirts.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, former Administrator Center area outskirts.

units.rawText: The storm of operands never once halted, the sector now run-down and dilapidated.
units.displayText: The storm of operands never once halted, the sector now run-down and dilapidated.

spans.text: The storm of operands never once halted, the sector now run-down and dilapidated.

units.rawText: With the agent's help, De Lacey made her arduous way through the sector.
units.displayText: With the agent's help, De Lacey made her arduous way through the sector.

spans.text: With the agent's help, De Lacey made her arduous way through the sector.

units.rawText: Over here, De Lacey!
units.displayText: Over here, De Lacey!

spans.text: Over here, De Lacey!

units.rawText: De Lacey, currently under a building with its upper floors blown off, caught sight of Sueyoi with half of his body visible. The agent immediately took De Lacey with her, dashing over.
units.displayText: De Lacey, currently under a building with its upper floors blown off, caught sight of Sueyoi with half of his body visible. The agent immediately took De Lacey with her, dashing over.

spans.text: De Lacey, currently under a building with its upper floors blown off, caught sight of Sueyoi with half of his body visible. The agent immediately took De Lacey with her, dashing over.

units.rawText: ...Why'd you take an agent with you?
units.displayText: ...Why'd you take an agent with you?

spans.text: ...Why'd you take an agent with you?

units.rawText: Ahaha, something of a payoff for my efforts! Where's Elaugh?
units.displayText: Ahaha, something of a payoff for my efforts! Where's Elaugh?

spans.text: Ahaha, something of a payoff for my efforts! Where's Elaugh?

units.rawText: The agent stood guard at the door as Sueyoi brought De Lacey below ground, into what remained of the Admin Center.
units.displayText: The agent stood guard at the door as Sueyoi brought De Lacey below ground, into what remained of the Admin Center.

spans.text: The agent stood guard at the door as Sueyoi brought De Lacey below ground, into what remained of the Admin Center.

units.rawText: ...God... Operand... Hunger
units.displayText: ...God... Operand... Hunger

spans.text: ...God... Operand... Hunger

units.rawText: Cold... Hot... Ascension... Sacrifice.
units.displayText: Cold... Hot... Ascension... Sacrifice.

spans.text: Cold... Hot... Ascension... Sacrifice.

units.rawText: Elaugh trembled and shuddered in a corner of the room, her knees clasped together with her arms, mumbling indiscernible phrases ad infinitum.
units.displayText: Elaugh trembled and shuddered in a corner of the room, her knees clasped together with her arms, mumbling indiscernible phrases ad infinitum.

spans.text: Elaugh trembled and shuddered in a corner of the room, her knees clasped together with her arms, mumbling indiscernible phrases ad infinitum.

units.rawText: ...How'd she get like this?
units.displayText: ...How'd she get like this?

spans.text: ...How'd she get like this?

units.rawText: Operand laxness, limb control in disarray, the first signs of complete neural breakdown...
units.displayText: Operand laxness, limb control in disarray, the first signs of complete neural breakdown...

spans.text: Operand laxness, limb control in disarray, the first signs of complete neural breakdown...

units.rawText: Suu, what did you do to her...
units.displayText: Suu, what did you do to her...

spans.text: Suu, what did you do to her...

units.rawText: None of my business. Ever since that monster up there got busted up, she's been like this.
units.displayText: None of my business. Ever since that monster up there got busted up, she's been like this.

spans.text: None of my business. Ever since that monster up there got busted up, she's been like this.

units.rawText: Even until the point of breakdown, Elaugh refused to tell me how to get Lind out of there.
units.displayText: Even until the point of breakdown, Elaugh refused to tell me how to get Lind out of there.

spans.text: Even until the point of breakdown, Elaugh refused to tell me how to get Lind out of there.

units.rawText: ...Might have to use some special methods then.
units.displayText: ...Might have to use some special methods then.

spans.text: ...Might have to use some special methods then.

units.rawText: De Lacey only hesitated for a moment, steadily taking apart her tail, plugging a cable into Elaugh.
units.displayText: De Lacey only hesitated for a moment, steadily taking apart her tail, plugging a cable into Elaugh.

spans.text: De Lacey only hesitated for a moment, steadily taking apart her tail, plugging a cable into Elaugh.

units.rawText: You're...?
units.displayText: You're...?

spans.text: You're...?

units.rawText: Stabilizing her neural systems, and... reading from her memory module.
units.displayText: Stabilizing her neural systems, and... reading from her memory module.

spans.text: Stabilizing her neural systems, and... reading from her memory module.

units.rawText: This goes against my occupational ethics, but we have no time for that.
units.displayText: This goes against my occupational ethics, but we have no time for that.

spans.text: This goes against my occupational ethics, but we have no time for that.

units.rawText: Elaugh's erratic operands soon settled down, and her chattering of strange jargon with them.
units.displayText: Elaugh's erratic operands soon settled down, and her chattering of strange jargon with them.

spans.text: Elaugh's erratic operands soon settled down, and her chattering of strange jargon with them.

units.rawText: So, anything about how to get Lind out?
units.displayText: So, anything about how to get Lind out?

spans.text: So, anything about how to get Lind out?

units.rawText: Lind, she's... Up there in that thing that's gone mad.
units.displayText: Lind, she's... Up there in that thing that's gone mad.

spans.text: Lind, she's... Up there in that thing that's gone mad.

units.rawText: How? I looked, that thing has no external modules attached, much less an agent.
units.displayText: How? I looked, that thing has no external modules attached, much less an agent.

spans.text: How? I looked, that thing has no external modules attached, much less an agent.

units.rawText: I'm talking about...
units.displayText: I'm talking about...

spans.text: I'm talking about...

units.rawText: De Lacey pursed her lips, pointing towards her own head.
units.displayText: De Lacey pursed her lips, pointing towards her own head.

spans.text: De Lacey pursed her lips, pointing towards her own head.

units.rawText: Lind's... In there.
units.displayText: Lind's... In there.

spans.text: Lind's... In there.

units.rawText: Sueyoi, in sheer disbelief, looked towards a broken window to his side. Between the crevasses of shattered buildings, the Great Creation's rampaging form could still be seen from time to time.
units.displayText: Sueyoi, in sheer disbelief, looked towards a broken window to his side. Between the crevasses of shattered buildings, the Great Creation's rampaging form could still be seen from time to time.

spans.text: Sueyoi, in sheer disbelief, looked towards a broken window to his side. Between the crevasses of shattered buildings, the Great Creation's rampaging form could still be seen from time to time.

units.rawText: On the Creation's head, in the place where the Sanctifier core once rested was a wound, great and cavernous.
units.displayText: On the Creation's head, in the place where the Sanctifier core once rested was a wound, great and cavernous.

spans.text: On the Creation's head, in the place where the Sanctifier core once rested was a wound, great and cavernous.

units.rawText: You're saying... Lind's in THERE?!
units.displayText: You're saying... Lind's in THERE?!

spans.text: You're saying... Lind's in THERE?!

units.rawText: What do we do, Suu...
units.displayText: What do we do, Suu...

spans.text: What do we do, Suu...

units.rawText: Can we stop her? That thing's a product of the sector, can we stop it with the administrative rights?
units.displayText: Can we stop her? That thing's a product of the sector, can we stop it with the administrative rights?

spans.text: Can we stop her? That thing's a product of the sector, can we stop it with the administrative rights?

units.rawText: Futile.
units.displayText: Futile.

spans.text: Futile.

units.rawText: Elaugh had awakened at some time or another, feebly lying on the ground, light no longer in her eyes.
units.displayText: Elaugh had awakened at some time or another, feebly lying on the ground, light no longer in her eyes.

spans.text: Elaugh had awakened at some time or another, feebly lying on the ground, light no longer in her eyes.

units.rawText: What administrative rights I have left are not even as complete as the God's.
units.displayText: What administrative rights I have left are not even as complete as the God's.

spans.text: What administrative rights I have left are not even as complete as the God's.

units.rawText: Didn't you make that thing?
units.displayText: Didn't you make that thing?

spans.text: Didn't you make that thing?

units.rawText: It was made by Elaugh and her lot for sure, but it also took with it most of the administrative rights.
units.displayText: It was made by Elaugh and her lot for sure, but it also took with it most of the administrative rights.

spans.text: It was made by Elaugh and her lot for sure, but it also took with it most of the administrative rights.

units.rawText: She used those rights to bind Lind to the core of that monster, which is what it took to awaken that thing.
units.displayText: She used those rights to bind Lind to the core of that monster, which is what it took to awaken that thing.

spans.text: She used those rights to bind Lind to the core of that monster, which is what it took to awaken that thing.

units.rawText: So that's why Lind's popped up in there...
units.displayText: So that's why Lind's popped up in there...

spans.text: So that's why Lind's popped up in there...

units.rawText: Give it up. When a God falls, all its believers are consigned to the grave alongside.
units.displayText: Give it up. When a God falls, all its believers are consigned to the grave alongside.

spans.text: Give it up. When a God falls, all its believers are consigned to the grave alongside.

units.rawText: Lind's no believer of your fraud of a God. Leave your cultish drivel for the other agents in this sector.
units.displayText: Lind's no believer of your fraud of a God. Leave your cultish drivel for the other agents in this sector.

spans.text: Lind's no believer of your fraud of a God. Leave your cultish drivel for the other agents in this sector.

units.rawText: BOOM!!
units.displayText: BOOM!!

spans.text: BOOM!!

units.rawText: The ground shuddered, dispelling the storm of operands, revealing the Great Creation in its midst.
units.displayText: The ground shuddered, dispelling the storm of operands, revealing the Great Creation in its midst.

spans.text: The ground shuddered, dispelling the storm of operands, revealing the Great Creation in its midst.

units.rawText: The Creation seemed baffled, looking back and forth in bewilderment.
units.displayText: The Creation seemed baffled, looking back and forth in bewilderment.

spans.text: The Creation seemed baffled, looking back and forth in bewilderment.

units.rawText: [Operand Transmat Initiating—Establishing Sector-Level Exclusionary Zone]
units.displayText: [Operand Transmat Initiating—Establishing Sector-Level Exclusionary Zone]

spans.text: [Operand Transmat Initiating—Establishing Sector-Level Exclusionary Zone]

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers all around the Ascension Sector began to radiate with glaring white light. In concurrence, a great curtain, carmine in color, rises from the edges of the sector, veiling the entirety of the sky.
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers all around the Ascension Sector began to radiate with glaring white light. In concurrence, a great curtain, carmine in color, rises from the edges of the sector, veiling the entirety of the sky.

spans.text: The Sanctifiers all around the Ascension Sector began to radiate with glaring white light. In concurrence, a great curtain, carmine in color, rises from the edges of the sector, veiling the entirety of the sky.

units.rawText: The Sanctifiers' exclusionary area! They're resetting the sector!
units.displayText: The Sanctifiers' exclusionary area! They're resetting the sector!

spans.text: The Sanctifiers' exclusionary area! They're resetting the sector!

units.rawText: Is the Ascension Sector already at a stage that necessitates resetting from the Sanctifiers?!
units.displayText: Is the Ascension Sector already at a stage that necessitates resetting from the Sanctifiers?!

spans.text: Is the Ascension Sector already at a stage that necessitates resetting from the Sanctifiers?!

units.rawText: Something's off! There must be a problem. By the Sanctifiers' standards, the Ascension Sector couldn't have crossed that line yet!
units.displayText: Something's off! There must be a problem. By the Sanctifiers' standards, the Ascension Sector couldn't have crossed that line yet!

spans.text: Something's off! There must be a problem. By the Sanctifiers' standards, the Ascension Sector couldn't have crossed that line yet!

units.rawText: Not the time for that! We've gotta stop the sector from resetting first, or everyone'll be reset to zero anyway!
units.displayText: Not the time for that! We've gotta stop the sector from resetting first, or everyone'll be reset to zero anyway!

spans.text: Not the time for that! We've gotta stop the sector from resetting first, or everyone'll be reset to zero anyway!

units.rawText: Suu, do you have the Haven System activation device?!
units.displayText: Suu, do you have the Haven System activation device?!

spans.text: Suu, do you have the Haven System activation device?!

units.rawText: Yeah, but...
units.displayText: Yeah, but...

spans.text: Yeah, but...

units.rawText: Sueyoi produces a rod-like object of refined assembly. De Lacey stares at it absently, as if suddenly thinking of something.
units.displayText: Sueyoi produces a rod-like object of refined assembly. De Lacey stares at it absently, as if suddenly thinking of something.

spans.text: Sueyoi produces a rod-like object of refined assembly. De Lacey stares at it absently, as if suddenly thinking of something.

units.rawText: But we'll need administrative rights to activate it...
units.displayText: But we'll need administrative rights to activate it...

spans.text: But we'll need administrative rights to activate it...

units.rawText: Looks like...
units.displayText: Looks like...

spans.text: Looks like...

units.rawText: Sueyoi activated the device in his hand, the control panel flashing lettering informing its user of a lack of rights.
units.displayText: Sueyoi activated the device in his hand, the control panel flashing lettering informing its user of a lack of rights.

spans.text: Sueyoi activated the device in his hand, the control panel flashing lettering informing its user of a lack of rights.

units.rawText: De Lacey, I'm going up.
units.displayText: De Lacey, I'm going up.

spans.text: De Lacey, I'm going up.

units.rawText: U-up? How?
units.displayText: U-up? How?

spans.text: U-up? How?

units.rawText: Your tail. I remember your model details, something about being suitable for the vast majority of disaster response situations. Your tail can extend far enough.
units.displayText: Your tail. I remember your model details, something about being suitable for the vast majority of disaster response situations. Your tail can extend far enough.

spans.text: Your tail. I remember your model details, something about being suitable for the vast majority of disaster response situations. Your tail can extend far enough.

units.rawText: You mean...!
units.displayText: You mean...!

spans.text: You mean...!

units.rawText: De Lacey thought back to her experiences in the Copley Sector not long ago.
units.displayText: De Lacey thought back to her experiences in the Copley Sector not long ago.

spans.text: De Lacey thought back to her experiences in the Copley Sector not long ago.

units.rawText: Throw me up there.
units.displayText: Throw me up there.

spans.text: Throw me up there.

units.rawText: No way! That's too dangerous! Even if you get up, how do you plan to get Lind out?
units.displayText: No way! That's too dangerous! Even if you get up, how do you plan to get Lind out?

spans.text: No way! That's too dangerous! Even if you get up, how do you plan to get Lind out?

units.rawText: Linny's neural systems are bound with that thing, how are you going to wake her up?
units.displayText: Linny's neural systems are bound with that thing, how are you going to wake her up?

spans.text: Linny's neural systems are bound with that thing, how are you going to wake her up?

units.rawText: Just a matter of entering her Tertiary Level, just like that time in Copley.
units.displayText: Just a matter of entering her Tertiary Level, just like that time in Copley.

spans.text: Just a matter of entering her Tertiary Level, just like that time in Copley.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: This is a chance we have to take.
units.displayText: This is a chance we have to take.

spans.text: This is a chance we have to take.

units.rawText: ...I understand.
units.displayText: ...I understand.

spans.text: ...I understand.

units.rawText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.
units.displayText: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

spans.text: Ascension Sector, former Admin Center area outskirts.

units.rawText: As if sensing threats abound, the Creation continually swung its lance back and forth, turning the sector into swiss cheese.
units.displayText: As if sensing threats abound, the Creation continually swung its lance back and forth, turning the sector into swiss cheese.

spans.text: As if sensing threats abound, the Creation continually swung its lance back and forth, turning the sector into swiss cheese.

units.rawText: De Lacey and Sueyoi stealthily circles around behind it through the ruins, discussing their options beneath ear-shattering roars.
units.displayText: De Lacey and Sueyoi stealthily circles around behind it through the ruins, discussing their options beneath ear-shattering roars.

spans.text: De Lacey and Sueyoi stealthily circles around behind it through the ruins, discussing their options beneath ear-shattering roars.

units.rawText: So what's the plan now?! We were talking about flinging you up there, but we can't even get close! It's just too big! We can't even survive the waves it makes from its movements!
units.displayText: So what's the plan now?! We were talking about flinging you up there, but we can't even get close! It's just too big! We can't even survive the waves it makes from its movements!

spans.text: So what's the plan now?! We were talking about flinging you up there, but we can't even get close! It's just too big! We can't even survive the waves it makes from its movements!

units.rawText: Don't rush! Let me think of something! There's always a way!
units.displayText: Don't rush! Let me think of something! There's always a way!

spans.text: Don't rush! Let me think of something! There's always a way!

units.rawText: We can find a tall building, and you throw me upwards from there!
units.displayText: We can find a tall building, and you throw me upwards from there!

spans.text: We can find a tall building, and you throw me upwards from there!

units.rawText: Does this sector still have buildings taller than two stories?! All of them are collapsed already!
units.displayText: Does this sector still have buildings taller than two stories?! All of them are collapsed already!

spans.text: Does this sector still have buildings taller than two stories?! All of them are collapsed already!

units.rawText: Then we'll have to just give it a go!
units.displayText: Then we'll have to just give it a go!

spans.text: Then we'll have to just give it a go!

units.rawText: Have you gone mad?!
units.displayText: Have you gone mad?!

spans.text: Have you gone mad?!

units.rawText: [BEEP—Detecting Unknown Communications Signal.]
units.displayText: [BEEP—Detecting Unknown Communications Signal.]

spans.text: [BEEP—Detecting Unknown Communications Signal.]

units.rawText: De Lacey picked up on the call.
units.displayText: De Lacey picked up on the call.

spans.text: De Lacey picked up on the call.

units.rawText: De Lacey, we can help you.
units.displayText: De Lacey, we can help you.

spans.text: De Lacey, we can help you.

units.rawText: How do you plan to do that?
units.displayText: How do you plan to do that?

spans.text: How do you plan to do that?

units.rawText: The fluid that De Lacey concocted to repair the fault in our neural systems is still present in large amounts in me and my compatriots.
units.displayText: The fluid that De Lacey concocted to repair the fault in our neural systems is still present in large amounts in me and my compatriots.

spans.text: The fluid that De Lacey concocted to repair the fault in our neural systems is still present in large amounts in me and my compatriots.

units.rawText: Our God is similar to us in composition. Upon approaching, it will naturally absorb us, and proceed to iterate.
units.displayText: Our God is similar to us in composition. Upon approaching, it will naturally absorb us, and proceed to iterate.

spans.text: Our God is similar to us in composition. Upon approaching, it will naturally absorb us, and proceed to iterate.

units.rawText: ...I don't get it, what are you trying to do?
units.displayText: ...I don't get it, what are you trying to do?

spans.text: ...I don't get it, what are you trying to do?

units.rawText: If it intakes too much of the fluid, it will, like us before, enter a brief period of dormancy.
units.displayText: If it intakes too much of the fluid, it will, like us before, enter a brief period of dormancy.

spans.text: If it intakes too much of the fluid, it will, like us before, enter a brief period of dormancy.

units.rawText: Wait, you're...
units.displayText: Wait, you're...

spans.text: Wait, you're...

units.rawText: Everything you have done for us, I have seen. Now, you and your companion continue to endeavor for our sake. It is time for us to help you.
units.displayText: Everything you have done for us, I have seen. Now, you and your companion continue to endeavor for our sake. It is time for us to help you.

spans.text: Everything you have done for us, I have seen. Now, you and your companion continue to endeavor for our sake. It is time for us to help you.

units.rawText: I didn't save you for you to throw your life away, and especially not for some sort of repayment!
units.displayText: I didn't save you for you to throw your life away, and especially not for some sort of repayment!

spans.text: I didn't save you for you to throw your life away, and especially not for some sort of repayment!

units.rawText: This is a necessary sacri—
units.displayText: This is a necessary sacri—

spans.text: This is a necessary sacri—

units.rawText: No! It isn't!
units.displayText: No! It isn't!

spans.text: No! It isn't!

units.rawText: De Lacey, emotions high, interrupted the agent.
units.displayText: De Lacey, emotions high, interrupted the agent.

spans.text: De Lacey, emotions high, interrupted the agent.

units.rawText: Think! Previously you did it for the Ascension Sector's insubstantial ideals, and now to supposedly repay me! This isn't sacrifice! It's suicide!
units.displayText: Think! Previously you did it for the Ascension Sector's insubstantial ideals, and now to supposedly repay me! This isn't sacrifice! It's suicide!

spans.text: Think! Previously you did it for the Ascension Sector's insubstantial ideals, and now to supposedly repay me! This isn't sacrifice! It's suicide!

units.rawText: How long has it been since you came to? Has it been long enough for you to get a grasp on the situation?!
units.displayText: How long has it been since you came to? Has it been long enough for you to get a grasp on the situation?!

spans.text: How long has it been since you came to? Has it been long enough for you to get a grasp on the situation?!

units.rawText: ...De Lacey, calm down.
units.displayText: ...De Lacey, calm down.

spans.text: ...De Lacey, calm down.

units.rawText: Sueyoi twists De Lacey's hand, grabbing the communication device.
units.displayText: Sueyoi twists De Lacey's hand, grabbing the communication device.

spans.text: Sueyoi twists De Lacey's hand, grabbing the communication device.

units.rawText: The two quickly moved towards the Great Creation's direction between the ruins.
units.displayText: The two quickly moved towards the Great Creation's direction between the ruins.

spans.text: The two quickly moved towards the Great Creation's direction between the ruins.

units.rawText: Whether it be a human or agent, everyone should have self-consciousness. That is necessary for sacrifice to be meaningful. Otherwise, you're just indulging in escapism.
units.displayText: Whether it be a human or agent, everyone should have self-consciousness. That is necessary for sacrifice to be meaningful. Otherwise, you're just indulging in escapism.

spans.text: Whether it be a human or agent, everyone should have self-consciousness. That is necessary for sacrifice to be meaningful. Otherwise, you're just indulging in escapism.

units.rawText: You escaped from thought before when your sector lost command and direction. Now, you must escape again from thinking how to solve the problems that you are presented with.
units.displayText: You escaped from thought before when your sector lost command and direction. Now, you must escape again from thinking how to solve the problems that you are presented with.

spans.text: You escaped from thought before when your sector lost command and direction. Now, you must escape again from thinking how to solve the problems that you are presented with.

units.rawText: Leave. We'll take care of this thing, and put a proper end to the mistakes you made.
units.displayText: Leave. We'll take care of this thing, and put a proper end to the mistakes you made.

spans.text: Leave. We'll take care of this thing, and put a proper end to the mistakes you made.

units.rawText: Yes. This is the aftermath of the Ascension Sector's deeds. We can contribute in its consummation.
units.displayText: Yes. This is the aftermath of the Ascension Sector's deeds. We can contribute in its consummation.

spans.text: Yes. This is the aftermath of the Ascension Sector's deeds. We can contribute in its consummation.

units.rawText: ...What are you? Nothing, that's what!
units.displayText: ...What are you? Nothing, that's what!

spans.text: ...What are you? Nothing, that's what!

units.rawText: BOOM—!!
units.displayText: BOOM—!!

spans.text: BOOM—!!

units.rawText: A great outcry interrupted the exchange. The Great Creation suddenly stopped in its steps, looking to its side as if it had discovered something.
units.displayText: A great outcry interrupted the exchange. The Great Creation suddenly stopped in its steps, looking to its side as if it had discovered something.

spans.text: A great outcry interrupted the exchange. The Great Creation suddenly stopped in its steps, looking to its side as if it had discovered something.

units.rawText: No... No! Stop!
units.displayText: No... No! Stop!

spans.text: No... No! Stop!

units.rawText: NO!!
units.displayText: NO!!

spans.text: NO!!

units.rawText: It saw. The morsels which it sought after so dearly had now congregated in one place, awaiting consumption.
units.displayText: It saw. The morsels which it sought after so dearly had now congregated in one place, awaiting consumption.

spans.text: It saw. The morsels which it sought after so dearly had now congregated in one place, awaiting consumption.

units.rawText: De Lacey, I have learnt many things from you.
units.displayText: De Lacey, I have learnt many things from you.

spans.text: De Lacey, I have learnt many things from you.

units.rawText: "Repairing" is an ability that we do not have. You can repair things, and make them how they were before.
units.displayText: "Repairing" is an ability that we do not have. You can repair things, and make them how they were before.

spans.text: "Repairing" is an ability that we do not have. You can repair things, and make them how they were before.

units.rawText: The Great Creation lurched towards its meal.
units.displayText: The Great Creation lurched towards its meal.

spans.text: The Great Creation lurched towards its meal.

units.rawText: "Right" and "wrong" is what holds influence over what we do. We say thanks for right things, and say sorry when we do something wrong.
units.displayText: "Right" and "wrong" is what holds influence over what we do. We say thanks for right things, and say sorry when we do something wrong.

spans.text: "Right" and "wrong" is what holds influence over what we do. We say thanks for right things, and say sorry when we do something wrong.

units.rawText: Every Doll or agent has an "ID", but "names" are unique, and are only representative of you.
units.displayText: Every Doll or agent has an "ID", but "names" are unique, and are only representative of you.

spans.text: Every Doll or agent has an "ID", but "names" are unique, and are only representative of you.

units.rawText: Sueyoi and De Lacey made their way to a nearby district, but found their way blocked by ruins.
units.displayText: Sueyoi and De Lacey made their way to a nearby district, but found their way blocked by ruins.

spans.text: Sueyoi and De Lacey made their way to a nearby district, but found their way blocked by ruins.

units.rawText: With Sueyoi's assistance De Lacey scaled the broken wall, and the two continued.
units.displayText: With Sueyoi's assistance De Lacey scaled the broken wall, and the two continued.

spans.text: With Sueyoi's assistance De Lacey scaled the broken wall, and the two continued.

units.rawText: Death is not yet a concept that I understand.
units.displayText: Death is not yet a concept that I understand.

spans.text: Death is not yet a concept that I understand.

units.rawText: Summating all information received so far, I should say to you now:
units.displayText: Summating all information received so far, I should say to you now:

spans.text: Summating all information received so far, I should say to you now:

units.rawText: The Great Creation began to lower its great form, devouring the agents who proffered themselves so kindly.
units.displayText: The Great Creation began to lower its great form, devouring the agents who proffered themselves so kindly.

spans.text: The Great Creation began to lower its great form, devouring the agents who proffered themselves so kindly.

units.rawText: "Thank you, De Lacey."
units.displayText: "Thank you, De Lacey."

spans.text: "Thank you, De Lacey."

units.rawText: Wait, no!
units.displayText: Wait, no!

spans.text: Wait, no!

units.rawText: [Beep—]
units.displayText: [Beep—]

spans.text: [Beep—]

units.rawText: The only response De Lacey receives was the unceremonious ringtone of a dropped line.
units.displayText: The only response De Lacey receives was the unceremonious ringtone of a dropped line.

spans.text: The only response De Lacey receives was the unceremonious ringtone of a dropped line.

units.rawText: The two finally arrived at the scene. Save for the Creation, now fallen into silence, there was only emptiness to be found.
units.displayText: The two finally arrived at the scene. Save for the Creation, now fallen into silence, there was only emptiness to be found.

spans.text: The two finally arrived at the scene. Save for the Creation, now fallen into silence, there was only emptiness to be found.

units.rawText: ...De Lacey, don't waste the chance they've created.
units.displayText: ...De Lacey, don't waste the chance they've created.

spans.text: ...De Lacey, don't waste the chance they've created.

units.rawText: Suu...
units.displayText: Suu...

spans.text: Suu...

units.rawText: ...What?
units.displayText: ...What?

spans.text: ...What?

units.rawText: Please, please, get our Linny back, and those administrative rights, too.
units.displayText: Please, please, get our Linny back, and those administrative rights, too.

spans.text: Please, please, get our Linny back, and those administrative rights, too.

units.rawText: ...Of course. I guarantee it.
units.displayText: ...Of course. I guarantee it.

spans.text: ...Of course. I guarantee it.

units.rawText: De Lacey sniffled a bit, resolve now solid in her eyes.
units.displayText: De Lacey sniffled a bit, resolve now solid in her eyes.

spans.text: De Lacey sniffled a bit, resolve now solid in her eyes.

units.rawText: She unlatches her tail, drawing out the longest data cable within, then ties it around Sueyoi's waist, and produces upwards force with all her might.
units.displayText: She unlatches her tail, drawing out the longest data cable within, then ties it around Sueyoi's waist, and produces upwards force with all her might.

spans.text: She unlatches her tail, drawing out the longest data cable within, then ties it around Sueyoi's waist, and produces upwards force with all her might.

units.rawText: Sueyoi's body drew an arc in midair, falling into the Great Creation's head area. A scattered sharp fragment met him as he landed, stabbing into his abdomen.
units.displayText: Sueyoi's body drew an arc in midair, falling into the Great Creation's head area. A scattered sharp fragment met him as he landed, stabbing into his abdomen.

spans.text: Sueyoi's body drew an arc in midair, falling into the Great Creation's head area. A scattered sharp fragment met him as he landed, stabbing into his abdomen.

units.rawText: Agh!!!
units.displayText: Agh!!!

spans.text: Agh!!!

units.rawText: Suu? Suu, are you alright?!
units.displayText: Suu? Suu, are you alright?!

spans.text: Suu? Suu, are you alright?!

units.rawText: I'm... fine...
units.displayText: I'm... fine...

spans.text: I'm... fine...

units.rawText: Painstakingly curving the edges of his lips, Sueyoi gave De Lacey in the communications projection a smile.
units.displayText: Painstakingly curving the edges of his lips, Sueyoi gave De Lacey in the communications projection a smile.

spans.text: Painstakingly curving the edges of his lips, Sueyoi gave De Lacey in the communications projection a smile.

units.rawText: Tilting his head, Sueyoi took a good look at the cranium's inner structures. Lind was embedded within the cranium's inner walls up to her torso, with a variety of conduits connected to her, some already detached.
units.displayText: Tilting his head, Sueyoi took a good look at the cranium's inner structures. Lind was embedded within the cranium's inner walls up to her torso, with a variety of conduits connected to her, some already detached.

spans.text: Tilting his head, Sueyoi took a good look at the cranium's inner structures. Lind was embedded within the cranium's inner walls up to her torso, with a variety of conduits connected to her, some already detached.

units.rawText: With a cold grunt, Sueyoi pulled the fragment out of his midsection, staggering towards Lind.
units.displayText: With a cold grunt, Sueyoi pulled the fragment out of his midsection, staggering towards Lind.

spans.text: With a cold grunt, Sueyoi pulled the fragment out of his midsection, staggering towards Lind.

units.rawText: Next time when we play hide-and-seek, pick somewhere that's not so hidden away, I beg of you.
units.displayText: Next time when we play hide-and-seek, pick somewhere that's not so hidden away, I beg of you.

spans.text: Next time when we play hide-and-seek, pick somewhere that's not so hidden away, I beg of you.

units.rawText: He pulled out a data cable provided by De Lacey, fiddling with Lind's ports.
units.displayText: He pulled out a data cable provided by De Lacey, fiddling with Lind's ports.

spans.text: He pulled out a data cable provided by De Lacey, fiddling with Lind's ports.

units.rawText: When we get back to Arcadia, I'm giving you a negative evaluation on our mission debriefings.
units.displayText: When we get back to Arcadia, I'm giving you a negative evaluation on our mission debriefings.

spans.text: When we get back to Arcadia, I'm giving you a negative evaluation on our mission debriefings.

units.rawText: Judgment's figure discharged a blinding light, splitting into two.
units.displayText: Judgment's figure discharged a blinding light, splitting into two.

spans.text: Judgment's figure discharged a blinding light, splitting into two.

units.rawText: Crime caught himself in midair, stabilizing, but Punishment plummeted towards the ground like a bird with a fractured wing.
units.displayText: Crime caught himself in midair, stabilizing, but Punishment plummeted towards the ground like a bird with a fractured wing.

spans.text: Crime caught himself in midair, stabilizing, but Punishment plummeted towards the ground like a bird with a fractured wing.

units.rawText: Punishment!!
units.displayText: Punishment!!

spans.text: Punishment!!

units.rawText: Crime manipulated his chains trying to catch Punishment midfall, yet his attempts were hastily avoided by the latter.
units.displayText: Crime manipulated his chains trying to catch Punishment midfall, yet his attempts were hastily avoided by the latter.

spans.text: Crime manipulated his chains trying to catch Punishment midfall, yet his attempts were hastily avoided by the latter.

units.rawText: Thump—
units.displayText: Thump—

spans.text: Thump—

units.rawText: Dust and smoke arose, Punishment coming into high-velocity contact with a block of ruins.
units.displayText: Dust and smoke arose, Punishment coming into high-velocity contact with a block of ruins.

spans.text: Dust and smoke arose, Punishment coming into high-velocity contact with a block of ruins.

units.rawText: Punishment? Punishment, where are you?!
units.displayText: Punishment? Punishment, where are you?!

spans.text: Punishment? Punishment, where are you?!

units.rawText: Don't... come... close...
units.displayText: Don't... come... close...

spans.text: Don't... come... close...

units.rawText: Punishment locates Crime within the smoke and dust. He attempted to approach, but a series of air-splitting slashes forced him back.
units.displayText: Punishment locates Crime within the smoke and dust. He attempted to approach, but a series of air-splitting slashes forced him back.

spans.text: Punishment locates Crime within the smoke and dust. He attempted to approach, but a series of air-splitting slashes forced him back.

units.rawText: When the dust settled, Punishment looked upon Crime, in all her glory.
units.displayText: When the dust settled, Punishment looked upon Crime, in all her glory.

spans.text: When the dust settled, Punishment looked upon Crime, in all her glory.

units.rawText: Once gleaming pearly white, Crime's body was now strewn all over with dark purple streaks. The scythe she always carried by her side now took on a new sickening shade of violet.
units.displayText: Once gleaming pearly white, Crime's body was now strewn all over with dark purple streaks. The scythe she always carried by her side now took on a new sickening shade of violet.

spans.text: Once gleaming pearly white, Crime's body was now strewn all over with dark purple streaks. The scythe she always carried by her side now took on a new sickening shade of violet.

units.rawText: You... you disengaged to save me...
units.displayText: You... you disengaged to save me...

spans.text: You... you disengaged to save me...

units.rawText: Why? How did you... How can a Sanctifier core coexist with Entropy?!
units.displayText: Why? How did you... How can a Sanctifier core coexist with Entropy?!

spans.text: Why? How did you... How can a Sanctifier core coexist with Entropy?!

units.rawText: Calm down.
units.displayText: Calm down.

spans.text: Calm down.

units.rawText: Impossible, even if it was Eucharist... No, I need to look for a way to...
units.displayText: Impossible, even if it was Eucharist... No, I need to look for a way to...

spans.text: Impossible, even if it was Eucharist... No, I need to look for a way to...

units.rawText: <size=40>I said calm down!!</size>
units.displayText: I said calm down!!

spans.text: I said calm down!!

units.rawText: I cannot resist this mutated strain of Entropy. It's evolved to be able to quickly infect Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: I cannot resist this mutated strain of Entropy. It's evolved to be able to quickly infect Sanctifiers.

spans.text: I cannot resist this mutated strain of Entropy. It's evolved to be able to quickly infect Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: Cleanse me, Punishment. If I am to be fully infected, both of us will surely be Entropized via connection in the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: Cleanse me, Punishment. If I am to be fully infected, both of us will surely be Entropized via connection in the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: Cleanse me, Punishment. If I am to be fully infected, both of us will surely be Entropized via connection in the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: ...I must report to Lord Hesperus first.
units.displayText: ...I must report to Lord Hesperus first.

spans.text: ...I must report to Lord Hesperus first.

units.rawText: The Black Goat rolled downwards, bouncing around on the ground.
units.displayText: The Black Goat rolled downwards, bouncing around on the ground.

spans.text: The Black Goat rolled downwards, bouncing around on the ground.

units.rawText: [Establishing Special Communications Channel—]
units.displayText: [Establishing Special Communications Channel—]

spans.text: [Establishing Special Communications Channel—]

units.rawText: [Target—Border Battlefront Command Center]
units.displayText: [Target—Border Battlefront Command Center]

spans.text: [Target—Border Battlefront Command Center]

units.rawText: [Recipient—Border Battlefront Supreme Commander-in-Chief—Hesperus]
units.displayText: [Recipient—Border Battlefront Supreme Commander-in-Chief—Hesperus]

spans.text: [Recipient—Border Battlefront Supreme Commander-in-Chief—Hesperus]

units.rawText: The buzzing began. Low and minute, but it rose above all the other clamorings of the battlefield.
units.displayText: The buzzing began. Low and minute, but it rose above all the other clamorings of the battlefield.

spans.text: The buzzing began. Low and minute, but it rose above all the other clamorings of the battlefield.

units.rawText: A projection appeared before Crime and Punishment. The man did not appear weathered or gray, but his form commanded staggering respect all the same.
units.displayText: A projection appeared before Crime and Punishment. The man did not appear weathered or gray, but his form commanded staggering respect all the same.

spans.text: A projection appeared before Crime and Punishment. The man did not appear weathered or gray, but his form commanded staggering respect all the same.

units.rawText: This is the Border Battlefront Command Center, Supreme Commander-in-Chief Hesperus speaking.
units.displayText: This is the Border Battlefront Command Center, Supreme Commander-in-Chief Hesperus speaking.

spans.text: This is the Border Battlefront Command Center, Supreme Commander-in-Chief Hesperus speaking.

units.rawText: Crime, report.
units.displayText: Crime, report.

spans.text: Crime, report.

units.rawText: Crime hastily told Hesperus of the events that have transpired.
units.displayText: Crime hastily told Hesperus of the events that have transpired.

spans.text: Crime hastily told Hesperus of the events that have transpired.

units.rawText: For a Greater to be Entropized is to disgrace the Sanctifiers. I am very disappointed, Crime.
units.displayText: For a Greater to be Entropized is to disgrace the Sanctifiers. I am very disappointed, Crime.

spans.text: For a Greater to be Entropized is to disgrace the Sanctifiers. I am very disappointed, Crime.

units.rawText: That device was disguised on the surface as a Sanctifier core, and was filled with Entropy...
units.displayText: That device was disguised on the surface as a Sanctifier core, and was filled with Entropy...

spans.text: That device was disguised on the surface as a Sanctifier core, and was filled with Entropy...

units.rawText: There was simply too much Entropy contained inside, in an instant it...
units.displayText: There was simply too much Entropy contained inside, in an instant it...

spans.text: There was simply too much Entropy contained inside, in an instant it...

units.rawText: I have no need for excuses, only results.
units.displayText: I have no need for excuses, only results.

spans.text: I have no need for excuses, only results.

units.rawText: We can make it up! The core of a Sanctifier can only come from the Reverse Babylon Tower...
units.displayText: We can make it up! The core of a Sanctifier can only come from the Reverse Babylon Tower...

spans.text: We can make it up! The core of a Sanctifier can only come from the Reverse Babylon Tower...

units.rawText: And an abnormal core at that! This is the finest proof of guilt!
units.displayText: And an abnormal core at that! This is the finest proof of guilt!

spans.text: And an abnormal core at that! This is the finest proof of guilt!

units.rawText: That is enough.
units.displayText: That is enough.

spans.text: That is enough.

units.rawText: Then, about Punishment...
units.displayText: Then, about Punishment...

spans.text: Then, about Punishment...

units.rawText: Any Sanctifier with a service record at the Border Battlefront should know well what is to be done.
units.displayText: Any Sanctifier with a service record at the Border Battlefront should know well what is to be done.

spans.text: Any Sanctifier with a service record at the Border Battlefront should know well what is to be done.

units.rawText: Yes, Crime will cleanse this body of mine, and sever my connection with him in the Sacred Canon.
units.displayText: Yes, Crime will cleanse this body of mine, and sever my connection with him in the Sacred Canon.

spans.text: Yes, Crime will cleanse this body of mine, and sever my connection with him in the Sacred Canon.

units.rawText: This...
units.displayText: This...

spans.text: This...

units.rawText: Crime compresses his eyelids together, the chains within his tightening clutch clanging together continuously.
units.displayText: Crime compresses his eyelids together, the chains within his tightening clutch clanging together continuously.

spans.text: Crime compresses his eyelids together, the chains within his tightening clutch clanging together continuously.

units.rawText: B-but...
units.displayText: B-but...

spans.text: B-but...

units.rawText: Hesperus paid no more heed to Crime. His projection turned, the emblems upon his body shining brilliantly.
units.displayText: Hesperus paid no more heed to Crime. His projection turned, the emblems upon his body shining brilliantly.

spans.text: Hesperus paid no more heed to Crime. His projection turned, the emblems upon his body shining brilliantly.

units.rawText: [Temporary Authority Granted, by the grace of Greater Sanctifier Leader Lord Hesperus.]
units.displayText: [Temporary Authority Granted, by the grace of Greater Sanctifier Leader Lord Hesperus.]

spans.text: [Temporary Authority Granted, by the grace of Greater Sanctifier Leader Lord Hesperus.]

units.rawText: This sector is beyond redemption. Reset it alongside Punishment.
units.displayText: This sector is beyond redemption. Reset it alongside Punishment.

spans.text: This sector is beyond redemption. Reset it alongside Punishment.

units.rawText: [Operand Transmat Limits Removed, Current Operand Class Transferrable—Until Disintegration.]
units.displayText: [Operand Transmat Limits Removed, Current Operand Class Transferrable—Until Disintegration.]

spans.text: [Operand Transmat Limits Removed, Current Operand Class Transferrable—Until Disintegration.]

units.rawText: Actions authorized. Sacrifice all Lessers, and establish a Sector-level Exclusionary Zone.
units.displayText: Actions authorized. Sacrifice all Lessers, and establish a Sector-level Exclusionary Zone.

spans.text: Actions authorized. Sacrifice all Lessers, and establish a Sector-level Exclusionary Zone.

units.rawText: Remember to report back to Eosphorus. Waste time no further.
units.displayText: Remember to report back to Eosphorus. Waste time no further.

spans.text: Remember to report back to Eosphorus. Waste time no further.

units.rawText: [Beep—]
units.displayText: [Beep—]

spans.text: [Beep—]

units.rawText: [Special Communications Channel Closed.]
units.displayText: [Special Communications Channel Closed.]
